limitations: Three or fewer selected, previously inspected open development failures; not heldout or general quality.
Lexical original versus lexical planned queries; this does not re-run or score the full hybrid RAG pipeline.
Only query hypotheses are generated; no answer, entailment verdict or user-facing fact is generated.
Keyword-language correctness and topical fidelity require review; structural validation cannot prove them.
Selected-source guards cover metadata, source hashes, sections, passage IDs and contributor roles; global ingestion may continue.
